authority: toscanini/conversational/nba_controller.py (the runtime controller) + orchestrator/next_best_action.py (the end-of-run epistemic record - unchanged, Art. LXIV)
purpose: The Next Best Action as the REAL controller: computed from the CURRENT recorded envelope before every stage boundary, consumed by the stage policy to determine the next execution path. The action actually determines the path (directive section 8); the decision and its full scored ledger are persisted (NBA_CONTROLLER.json) so 'why did the engine stop/skip here' is always an auditable record.
directive_reference: CODER 1 - DISCOVERY INTELLIGENCE / CLAUDE-LIKE PROBLEM PROCESSING, section 8

action_vocabulary.RETRIEVE_MORE_EVIDENCE: more retrieval materially reduces uncertainty (verified items < 3 AND the frozen base is small)
action_vocabulary.GENERATE_COMPETING_MECHANISM: evidence sufficient, no mechanism yet - synthesize with H1/H2/H3 competing (section 15)
action_vocabulary.ATTACK_CANDIDATE: a mechanism exists but no recorded attack - the gauntlet is the highest-impact uncertainty reducer
action_vocabulary.ENGINEERING_ESCALATION: candidate survived attack - escalate toward engineering representation (section 5)
action_vocabulary.PROPOSE_DECISIVE_EXPERIMENT: high-value survivor with a recorded killer-experiment contract (Art. LII)
action_vocabulary.ASK_CLARIFICATION: the Problem Understanding flags a field whose answer materially changes the search space (section 4)
action_vocabulary.STOP_HONEST: classification ran, the evidence base is adequate (>= 8 records), and ZERO items support any mechanism of the stated problem - problem existence unestablished (Art. XX; directive section 5)
action_vocabulary.PACKAGE_READY: engineering representation recorded - the buyer package is the remaining transfer step

action_fields.required_capability: the capability class that would execute it
action_fields.risk: the declared risk of taking (or refusing) the action
action_fields.score: (gain x p_change x impact) / cost - redundancy_penalty

scoring.provenance: the SAME V4 shape as orchestrator/next_best_action.py (one scoring authority, two sites); the runtime controller records the standing formula, it does not invent a second one
scoring.selection: exactly ONE preferred action = highest score; returned with the full ranked ledger

cost_provenance: MODEL_DERIVED - order-of-magnitude planning constants derived from the engine's call-site structure (adapters.py static LLM call-sites per stage) and the recorded routing ledger latency_ms distribution (ENGINE_RUNS/model_routing/ledger.jsonl, 612 lines). Used ONLY to rank controller actions by cost; never quoted as a measured result (Art. XXVII).

llm_calls_per_stage.provenance: COMPUTED from source: static count of llm_registry.generate() call sites reachable from each stage's adapter (R446 audit)

declared_thresholds.provenance: MODEL_DERIVED (Art. XXVII) - a base of >= 8 frozen records is a reasonable retrieval attempt for the problem-binding decision (aligned with the engine's depth-contract record floors); below it, more retrieval is the honest next move

control_wiring.engine: EngineRun(stage_gate=...) calls the controller before every stage; the stage policy consumes the preferred action to return RUN/SKIP/DEFER/BLOCK/STOP
control_wiring.worker: toscanini/worker.py phase 3 constructs the gate closure; every controller decision is persisted to the run dir (NBA_CONTROLLER.json, last-wins)
control_wiring.record: ranked_actions + preferred_action + decided_from (the measured state the decision rested on)

honesty_guards: The decision is computed from RECORDED state only - never from inference about what a stage would produce
The absent-classification guard: STOP_HONEST never fires when the claim-level classification has not run (absence of the record is not a zero-support verdict, Art. XXV)
The adequate-base guard: a small evidence base earns RETRIEVE_MORE, never a stop (Art. V - not a universal rejector)
A controller failure fails OPEN to RUN - the orchestration layer can never hold the epistemic chain hostage
